method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (dda-core.l4, Act and Regulations, built-in date functions only) and two seat layers (the claimant, required; the defendant) that restate no rule; answers are named outcomes, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no regulative rule (the Act puts no duty with a deadline on either party); no REFUSE, no BECAUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Dust Diseases Act 2005 (SA), register version 1.1.2021, and Dust Diseases Regulations 2021 (SA), register version 17.6.2021, both fetched from www.legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 (unauthorised RTFs; not the Open Australian Legal Corpus), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/dust-diseases-act-2005.txt (text sha256 e021e2494700fd329372b6248496370cfee09e7c95290e150fd1b1b1b5ab2c1e) and ../../../dust-diseases-regulations-2021/registers/source-bundle/dust-diseases-regulations-2021.txt (text sha256 ea679183800c7f83409bdf10e9d8c90b9a62e72279b8eba41b642d872b7b66ec), per their meta.json.

seats: the claimant: the plaintiff in a dust disease action, usually the injured person, or after a death the estate or dependants suing for it (dda-seat.l4)
the defendant: the person or business sued, another tortfeasor liable for the same damage, or the insurer sued directly under s 11 (dda-seat-defendant.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run dda-core.l4 ; l4 run dda-seat.l4 ; l4 run dda-seat-defendant.l4 ; l4 run dda-cases.l4 ; l4 run dda-cases-defendant.l4
checks.result: 144 assertions written, 144 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control (Sch 1 cl 1 'more than 20 persons' changed to 'at least 20') failed exactly the 5 predicted assertions and was reverted
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: Act ss 3, 4A, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 11A and Sch 1 cl 4; Dust Diseases Regulations 2021 regs 4, 5 and Schedules 1, 2. Out: s 1, s 4 (object), s 12 (regulations), regs 1 to 3 and Sch 3 (machinery); ss 2 and 6 and Sch 1 Pts 1 to 3 (not in the text); quantum of damages and costs, SAET procedure (other Acts). Reasons in NOTES.md.
